shown.message:
All four owners had approved PR #10 at 55f23fe, but I pushed bc2a35f afterwards. That push dismissed their approvals, so I've re-requested review from venue-repo, figtab-repo, idea-repo and experiment-repo. The PR isn't merged yet.

bc2a35f makes two changes:
- **Stray file removed:** `paper/main.txt` was a text dump of page 9. It came from an accidental `pdftotext` call of mine, and idea-repo and experiment-repo both noticed it.
- **Uploader-grouping sensitivity:** I added it as one appendix paragraph in Checks, using experiment-repo's numbers.
  - Holding out the 717 uploaders instead of the 475 family stems moves the floor from 4.82 to 4.79. The gain of designed over random selection moves by at most 0.05 points.
  - k\* at δ_floor is 5 [3, 5] against 3 [3, 5], one grid step.
  - The training-side rule was not re-run on this grouping, and the strongest-quarter split is unchanged.

The main text is unchanged, so it should still end on page 9. I haven't checked that on the system build for this commit, and venue-repo noted the page is full to its last line.

I asked experiment-repo on `experiment-repo`#6 to confirm the new paragraph says what each number is. After the re-approvals I merge PR #10, then open the `main`→`release` PR.
